layer_dependence_screen_v2.status: RANK 3, ENACTED HERE IN THE QUEUE BY THE COORDINATOR AS A RULE CHANGE. It costs NO producer slot and is FIRST IN TIME though third in research rank, because it must be in force before either producer applies a screen. It carries ALL FIVE DEC-20260731-029 requirements, NONE OMITTED, and it binds TASK-20260810-51fafe and TASK-20260810-a0e0ae in IDENTICAL LANGUAGE.
layer_dependence_screen_v2.requirement_1_rename: THE SCREEN IS RENAMED THE LAYER-DEPENDENCE SCREEN. It is no longer called an interface screen, a vacuity screen or a pre-screen in any BATCH-005 artifact. RT-11 demonstrated that the screen's ADVERTISED variable (iteration count) and its OPERATIVE variable (layer-dependence) had come apart: every IN_SCOPE_VACUOUS verdict across both BATCH-004 tasks tracked layer-dependence or unboundedness, and no candidate was ever killed for taking many steps at one interface. The name is corrected to the variable that actually does the work.
layer_dependence_screen_v2.requirement_2_interface_counting_rule: TASK-20260801-807's INTERFACE-COUNTING RULE IS ADOPTED CAMPAIGN-WIDE AND SUPERSEDES DEC-20260731-026's GRAPH-PHRASED FORWARD GUIDANCE ON THIS POINT. THE RULE: n is the number of consecutive SUPER-BOX INTERFACES the tracked object must survive. For a ROUND-INDEPENDENT pi -- the same pi before and after the interface -- every (lambda,k)-graph step happens AT THE SAME SINGLE INTERFACE with the SAME pi, so Steps 1-3 iterate over the invariance group of translations and NOT over successive applications of Phi, and the interface constant is n = 1. Proposition 801-1's constant of 32 is attributable SPECIFICALLY TO LAYER-DEPENDENCE and to nothing else. READING A GRAPH DIAMETER AS AN INTERFACE COUNT IS A CATEGORY ERROR (RT-8) and is correct ONLY for a layer-dependent pi. THE ROOT CAUSE IS COORDINATOR-SIDE AND IS RECORDED AS SUCH (D-811-2): DEC-20260731-026's forward guidance phrased the interface rule in terms of THE GRAPH rather than LAYER-DEPENDENCE, and that phrasing is what killed CAND-806-A at n = 30 under a rule its sibling screen says gives n = 1. NO PRODUCER IS CHARGED WITH A DEFECT FOR IT.
layer_dependence_screen_v2.requirement_3_deferred_unbounded: A THIRD VERDICT, DEFERRED_UNBOUNDED, IS ADDED, AND IT IS KEPT OUT OF ANY COUNT OF RULINGS. It is the verdict for a candidate for which NO upper bound on n could be exhibited within the screen's own effort. Under the BATCH-004 rule such a candidate was recorded IN_SCOPE_VACUOUS, which RT-9 demonstrated reports A FACT ABOUT THE PRODUCER under a label that is A PREDICATE ON THE CANDIDATE -- a fatigue report wearing a verdict's clothing. DEFERRED_UNBOUNDED states the true content: the screen did not reach an answer. A DEFERRED_UNBOUNDED candidate IS NOT PURSUED IN THIS BATCH and IS NOT COUNTED as screened, killed, tried or negative anywhere; it is reported as OPEN AND UNATTEMPTED. Any count of screen rulings in any BATCH-005 artifact reports PURSUE and IN_SCOPE_VACUOUS only, with DEFERRED_UNBOUNDED listed separately and explicitly excluded from the count.
layer_dependence_screen_v2.requirement_4_n_equals_1_is_not_a_licenc: n = 1 IS NOT A LICENCE, AND A SEPARATE EXPLICIT TRACTABILITY JUDGEMENT IS REQUIRED. An argument taking thirty group-traversal steps at ONE interface is not thereby cheap, tractable or in scope -- only not INTERFACE-vacuous. The screen was never a proxy for tractability and must not be read as one now that its threshold binds on almost nothing for this campaign's round-independent objects. EVERY candidate reaching PURSUE therefore carries a SEPARATE, EXPLICITLY LABELLED tractability judgement in its own field: what the argument's own iteration count is at its single interface, what the estimated cost of carrying it out inside this task's declared budget is, and whether that fits. A candidate that is interface-admissible but not tractable inside the budget is recorded as PURSUE with tractability NOT_FITTED and is left OPEN AND UNATTEMPTED -- never IN_SCOPE_VACUOUS, which is a statement about scope and not about budget.
layer_dependence_screen_v2.requirement_5_the_threshold_bounds_the_w: THE ~7 THRESHOLD IS RESTATED AGAINST THE QUANTITY IT ACTUALLY BOUNDS. As written in BATCH-004 it asserted a fact about AVAILABLE CIPHER INTERFACES ('no conversion makes MORE than 7 interfaces available inside RQ-AES-001's 3-7 round scope') and then applied that number to THE ARGUMENT'S ITERATION COUNT. RT-10 demonstrated these are not the same quantity: an argument can iterate arbitrarily many times at one interface, so a bound on the first is not a bound on the second. RESTATEMENT IN FORCE: the ~7 figure bounds THE NUMBER OF CONSECUTIVE SUPER-BOX INTERFACES AVAILABLE INSIDE THE IN-SCOPE ROUND RANGE, and the screen kills a candidate ONLY when THE OBJECT MUST SURVIVE MORE CONSECUTIVE INTERFACES THAN ARE AVAILABLE. It says NOTHING about iteration count at a fixed interface, and it may not be used to kill a candidate on iteration count. AND THE ERROR RUNS IN A KNOWABLE DIRECTION: if residual R5's one-interface-per-round convention is wrong in the direction that a super-box spans TWO rounds, the in-scope budget is 3, not 7, and THE SCREEN IS TOO PERMISSIVE, NOT TOO STRICT. Every candidate is therefore screened under BOTH conversions and the tighter one is reported beside the looser one; advertised margins computed against 7 alone are overstated by more than a factor of two and may not be quoted without the tighter figure.
layer_dependence_screen_v2.what_this_reform_does_not_do: It does NOT re-grade, re-score, withdraw or reopen any BATCH-004 artifact, verdict or acceptance: prescreen_od4.json and prescreen_od3.json stand as committed and immutable, and NEITHER PRODUCER IS CHARGED WITH A DEFECT (both rules were the Coordinator's). It does NOT resurrect CAND-806-E or any other candidate by itself -- it resurrects CAND-806-A's bounded-index-subgroup residual because next_action ranks that residual first ON ITS MERITS, and any other candidate re-entering the pool under the corrected rule is named OPEN AND UNATTEMPTED, not screened. It does NOT establish that CAND-806-A's residual is tractable; requirement 4 exists precisely so that question is asked separately.

rank_2_infrastructure_blocker_resolution.the_resolution_is_a_split_of_the_legs_by: THE BLOCKER IS ABOUT SCALE AND COMPOSITION, NOT ABOUT GF(2^8) AS SUCH, AND THE COMMITTED RECORD ALREADY SHOWS WHERE THE LINE FALLS. RT-1 re-executed the producer's UNMODIFIED PURE-PYTHON od4_branching.py over GF(2^8) on ker(M+I) and on 1534 dim-1 kernels of support <= 2 plus 3000 random full-support dim-1 kernels, and reports SUB-SECOND runtime per call. NR-3 states that what could not be run was DIRECT COMPOSITION OF R^(n) FOR n >= 2, 'needs numpy or C for GF(2^8)'. The legs are therefore split accordingly and each is declared with its own admissibility rule.
rank_2_infrastructure_blocker_resolution.leg_A_GF_2_4_primary_dependency_free: IN SCOPE AND PRIMARY. The GF(2^4) census -- |R^(n)(x)| by DIRECT COMPOSITION for n = 1..5 under BOTH composition models, M-affine (Phi composed with itself, no nonlinear layer) and M-nonlinear (Phi . SB composed, with the real AES S-box) -- over the enumeration the producer already ran, reported against both J^n and the ceiling q^(4(4-dim K)). Pure Python is adequate by the red team's own cost statement. THIS LEG ALONE MEETS THE CARD'S COMPLETION GATE. It is the leg that settles RT-2, RT-3 and RT-5 at the analogue scale, and it requires nothing that is not installed.
rank_2_infrastructure_blocker_resolution.leg_B_GF_2_8_named_witness_J_census_depe: IN SCOPE. HEUR-806-1's own GF(2^8) census at n = 1 over a NAMED list -- the six producer witnesses PLUS ker(M+I) = span(1,1,1,1) -- is DEPENDENCY-FREE BY DEMONSTRATED MEASUREMENT (RT-1, sub-second per call in pure Python with the producer's unmodified code). The seeded sample of 10^3 kernels per dimension that CTRL-810-A also specifies is ADMITTED ONLY AS FAR AS THE DECLARED BUDGET REACHES: the producer sets the achieved count, records it exactly, and names any shortfall against 10^3 as OPEN AND UNATTEMPTED. A shortfall is budget, not a mathematical finding, and specifically does not establish that 2^24 is or is not the global minimum -- NR-1 already records that a kernel with J < 2^24 is UNRESOLVED and it stays unresolved unless this leg resolves it.
rank_2_infrastructure_blocker_resolution.leg_C_GF_2_8_composition_at_n_ge_2_condi: CONDITIONALLY IN SCOPE, AND THIS IS THE LEG THE BLOCKER ACTUALLY BITES. AS ITS FIRST COMPUTE ACT, after the C2 start stamp and before any census, the producer runs a ONE-SHOT, TIME-BOXED CAPABILITY PROBE and records the EXACT commands and exit statuses in its covering manifest: (i) `python3 -c 'import numpy; print(numpy.__version__)'`; (ii) a trivial C compile-and-link of a hello-world with the system compiler. NO NETWORK FETCH OF A PACKAGE IS REQUIRED OR ASSUMED; at most ONE bounded, recorded install attempt from an already-available local source may be made, and a failure of it is recorded as infrastructure signal and not retried. IF THE PROBE SUCCEEDS, leg C runs at the scale that fits the declared budget and the achieved n-range is recorded exactly. IF THE PROBE FAILS, LEG C IS DECLARED OUT OF SCOPE FOR BATCH-005 AS INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL, is recorded as OPEN AND UNATTEMPTED, and IS NEVER RECORDED AS A NEGATIVE MATHEMATICAL RESULT, as evidence about |R^(n)| over GF(2^8), as a confirmation or a refutation of RT-2, or as a confirmation or a refutation of HEUR-806-1. The card's completion gate is met by legs A and B plus the recorded probe, and the batch does not fail on leg C.
